description: The 15 April SET general assembly is reported, but venue, public access and attendance are unknown. The separate nationwide 17–19 April strike closed schools; neither workforce nor affected-teacher numbers establish a qualifying public gathering.
required_followup: Search permitted local contemporaneous sources for venue/open status and simultaneous attendance; retain pending threshold if absent.

description: The opened Anadolu article reports the SET nationwide teachers’ strike for 17–19 April but no street march, rally, sit-in or qualifying public gathering. Its 2,200 figure is the number of teachers said to have unpaid salaries, not strikers or attendees.
required_followup: Do not code the work stoppage as a protest event absent evidence it became a public event. If other source yields a specific public action, assess separately.
